Legacy identity: `FOS-000024`. Original source: [immutable historical definition](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/73f891d6c0cf498ac92e804d7d0f0cd344a083f5/local-docs/reviews/observability-sweep.md).

Shared requirements and grouping: https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/issues/8. All original criteria below remain required. Source status statements below describe their historical revision; current delivery evidence is recorded separately. Original relative links are resolved below.

## Original definition (verbatim)

24. **FOS-000024 — Bound diagnostics without sampling away outcomes.** **M, subsystem increments; depends on `FOS-000009`, `FOS-000012`, `FOS-000013`, `FOS-000014`, `FOS-000020`; §4–§5.** [spam limiting:88](https://github.com/robinwassen/Fossilize/blob/556da9ff7d7616704dda515756219ab1dab693ec/fossilize_errors.hpp#L88) already bounds several call sites, but static counters span calls/recorders and only expose a silencing message; many CLI failures log per item. Add per-run/session reason totals, bounded examples, sampled/dropped/truncated counts and event severity/time. Keep these independent of authoritative final item accounting. Make expensive timing/tracing opt-in and avoid baseline shader dumps, environment values or sensitive absolute paths; retain a caller-controlled path/detail policy. **Check:** many repeated failures, multiple runs in one process, ring overload, long messages and blocked/failed sink. Require bounded baseline memory/overhead and the same final counts with verbose logging enabled or disabled. Establish measurements before picking performance budgets.

   **Required automated success criteria — pending implementation:**

   - **Diagnostic/accounting stress tests:** For N repeated failures above the sample cap, authoritative reason/item counts remain correct while examples/queue state respect documented numeric caps; sampled/dropped/truncated counts explain loss. Repeating runs in one process resets session-local budgets and counters.
   - **Privacy/verbosity tests:** Run the same workload with diagnostics off, normal and verbose: final outcomes/counts are identical. Sentinel shader text, secret environment values and sensitive paths do not appear in baseline outputs under the chosen detail policy. Events carry valid severity/time and preserve documented units.
   - **Automated resource-budget check:** Before completing this item, define measurable baseline memory/overhead limits and a reproducible benchmark configuration. The registered benchmark enforces those limits with documented tolerance; expensive tracing is disabled by default. A blocked/failing sink cannot cause unbounded buffering or alter operation results.
